header: The All-India Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (AICPI-IW), taken from the Labour Bureau's own pages (src/lib/live/aicpi.ts): the CPI-IW page, whose chart holds the last twelve months, and the home page, whose box holds the latest two (the newest month is there first). I read nothing from the caller: the two addresses are fixed. The home page failing is not an error (the chart alone is a year); the CPI-IW page failing or changing is, and then I return the last good answer and mark it as such. The index changes once a month, so I keep an answer for six hours.
